# UberFix

> UberFix is an integrated maintenance management platform for the Egyptian market — receive maintenance requests, dispatch technicians, track SLAs, and manage invoices, all in one system.

UberFix connects customers with vetted technicians through web, WhatsApp, and a public intake gateway. The platform covers the full maintenance lifecycle: request, assignment, execution, invoicing, and feedback.

## Pages

- [Home](/): UberFix overview, services, and how the platform works.
- [About](/about): Company story, mission, and team.
- [Services](/services): Maintenance categories covered (AC, electrical, plumbing, fit-out).
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from completed maintenance projects.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles, tips, and industry updates.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about requests, pricing, and coverage.
- [Book a Consultation](/book-consultation): Free Arabic consultation booking wizard.
- [Request Service](/uf): Public maintenance request form.
- [Request a Quote](/quote): Submit a project bid request.
- [Track Order](/track): Track the status of an existing maintenance request.
- [Sitemap](/sitemap): Directory of public pages.
